name: [UPD 0.7] Choices of Immortals
desc:
Choices of Immortals 🔥
Welcome to Choices of Immortals, a Murim-style cultivation RPG simulator inspired by your favorite manhwa and xianxia worlds! 🌙

🧘‍♂️ Cultivate your way to Immortality!
Start as a mere mortal and rise through the heavens. Join a sect or go rogue, master your affinities, and unlock the secrets of true power.

⚔️ Forge Your Own Path
Will you battle through endless enemies or find peace through meditation?
🌋 Burn with Fire Qi
☠️ Infect the world with Plague Qi
🌿 Master balance, creation, or destruction — it’s your destiny.

💰 Build your empire, expand your influence, and transcend the mortal realm.
The paths are endless, and every choice shapes your fate.

Will you become a master of a global trading company or will you be an immortal by cultivating

✨ Experience a new age of 2D Cultivation RPG gameplay.
Will you become a Legend, or fade into history?


Tags: Manwha , Murim , Martial Arts , Cultivation , Stronger , Exploration, Solo Leveling, Towers
